summary: @ornikar/repo-config preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, an obfuscator.io-style script that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub's oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods the `bun` binary executable, and invokes it against a 727KB heavily obfuscated sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with rotated string arrays and mangled identifiers, and its name bears no relation to the package's advertised purpose (a prettier/commitlint/husky repo-config). Installing the package on default `npm install` auto-executes the obfuscated payload under a fetched alternate runtime, producing arbitrary code execution on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
